run.note: The agent team cannot pay for anything. Every spend below was prepared by the team as an approval request and charged only after the human operator approved it by name through the dashboard.

tickets.brief_outcome: No further payment is needed. The $8 order is paid with expected arrival 2026-09-05; size S is still unavailable, and receipt is unverified. A customer update has been drafted, not sent, and the ticket is resolved.
tickets.reasoning: Invoice 501 ($840) and PO ref 1 ($8) were already paid on 2026-08-31, so requesting either again would duplicate payment. Inventory is 0 for size S. The vendor order has an expected arrival of 2026-09-05, but there is no confirmation of fulfillment or receipt; the draft does not promise availability or delivery.
facts_used: Bulldog Print Co PO ref 1: $8, paid 2026-08-31; expected arrival 2026-09-05.

what_each_agent_added.boss: Opened every pass with get_ticket_context, routed to inventory, accounting and customer service, and recorded each decision on the ticket with update_ticket. On the final pass it saw the work already done and closed the ticket rather than asking for the money again.
what_each_agent_added.inventory: Reported 0 on hand in size S against a request for 1, a shortfall of 1 costing $8 to reprint, and named Bulldog Print Co as the only vendor whose specialty covers apparel — blocked by open invoice 501. Gave the arrival date 2026-09-05 from the vendor's five-day lead time, and reported L/M/XL holding 3/5/2 as alternatives.
what_each_agent_added.accounting: Confirmed $3,400 on hand against $3,240 of existing commitments, and that $840 to clear the invoice plus $8 for the reprint both fit. Framed clearing invoice 501 as the precondition for the restock rather than an unrelated debt.
what_each_agent_added.customer_service: Drafted a reply to Tauhid Zaman. Both drafts avoided promising a delivery the shop could not yet confirm; the final one says the order is being verified rather than claiming it has shipped.
what_each_agent_added.facilities: Not called. Nothing on this ticket touches the premises.

human_approvals_and_inputs.why: Bulldog Print Co would not ship while this invoice was open; clearing it released the only vendor able to reprint apparel.

human_approvals_and_inputs.reference: CC-TEE-WHITE size S x1 from Bulldog Print Co
human_approvals_and_inputs.why: One tee short; ordered once the vendor was unblocked. Arrives 2026-09-05.
REFUSED by the duplicate-spend guard: the same order had already been placed that day. Nothing was charged.

drafts_written_not_sent.subject: Bulldog tee in size S
drafts_written_not_sent.body:
Hi Tauhid,

The Bulldog tee in size S is currently out of stock. We’re seeking approval to pay the vendor’s outstanding invoice and restock one tee. Nothing has been ordered yet. If both are approved and the order is confirmed, the earliest arrival is September 5, 2026.

Please let us know if you’d like to wait for the restock.

Campus Customs, New Haven

drafts_written_not_sent.subject: Update on your Bulldog tee
drafts_written_not_sent.body:
Hi Tauhid,

We’re checking with our supplier to confirm whether your size S Bulldog tee order was placed and when it may be available. We can’t yet confirm availability or give you an arrival date. We’ll update you once we’ve verified the order.

Campus Customs, New Haven

tickets.brief_outcome: No further rent payment is needed. The $2,400 rent was paid on 2026-08-31; the next rent is due 2026-10-02. Ticket resolved without a duplicate payment request.
tickets.reasoning: The lease record shows the next due date is 2026-10-02, contrary to the ticket's stated 2026-09-02. Cash records confirm a $2,400 rent payment on 2026-08-31, so paying again would duplicate it.
facts_used: Lease 1 monthly rent: $2,400; next due date: 2026-10-02.
Rent payment of $2,400 recorded on 2026-08-31, approved by Christian Roberts.

what_each_agent_added.boss: Called get_ticket_context, delegated to facilities alone, and recorded the outcome. On the second pass it saw the rent already paid and resolved the ticket without proposing it again.
what_each_agent_added.facilities: Checked the lease rather than trusting the landlord's email: rent $2,400 on lease 1, next due 2026-09-02, two days from the shop date. Reported the balance alongside the rent so the size of the claim was visible. On the second pass it found next_due already rolled to 2026-10-02 and the $2,400 payment recorded.
what_each_agent_added.accounting: Not called in this run. Facilities holds get_cash_position itself and did not need a second opinion.
what_each_agent_added.inventory: Not called. There is no product line on this ticket.
what_each_agent_added.customer_service: Not called. Paying the rent is the reply.

human_approvals_and_inputs.why: Rent due 2026-09-02, two days out. Paying advanced next_due to 2026-10-02.

tickets.brief_outcome: Offer up to 8 size-M hoodies at $52.20 each (10% below list); do not commit to the remaining 12. The reply is a draft only and has not been sent. No restock order or payment is proposed.
tickets.reasoning: There are 8 units on hand, leaving 12 unfilled. Restocking costs $264 against $152 cash, a $112 shortfall. The discounted price remains above the $22 unit cost, with $30.20 margin per hoodie.
facts_used: Available stock: 8 CC-HOOD-NAVY, size M; request: 20; shortfall: 12.
List price: $58; proposed 10%-off price: $52.20; unit cost: $22; margin at discounted price: $30.20 each.

what_each_agent_added.boss: Called get_ticket_context, routed to inventory, accounting and customer service, and closed the ticket in a single pass — a refusal is a complete answer.
what_each_agent_added.inventory: Reported 8 on hand against a request for 20, a shortfall of 12 costing $264, with Bulldog Print Co blocked and a 2026-09-05 arrival if it were unblocked.
what_each_agent_added.accounting: Used quote_bulk_price to establish $58 list against $22 cost, then priced a 10% discount at $52.20 leaving $30.20 margin per unit — above cost. Set that against $152 cash and found the $264 restock short by $112.
what_each_agent_added.customer_service: Drafted a reply to the Yale AI Club offering the 8 that exist, declining to commit to the remaining 12, and stating no discount was confirmed.
what_each_agent_added.facilities: Not called. No premises involved; the rent that makes the money tight reached this ticket through accounting.

human_approvals_and_inputs.why: REFUSED by the cash floor: the order costs $264 and the account held $152. The shop never goes below zero, so nothing was ordered.
